c4d-highcpu-8.note_c4d_ram: C4D RAM SKU is priced per decimal GB (GBy.h, baseUnitConversionFactor=3.6e12 By.s). If Google instead billed the nominal 15 'GB', RAM would be $39.81/mo instead of $42.74/mo (total $238.44/mo).

c4d-highcpu-16.note_c4d_ram: C4D RAM SKU is priced per decimal GB (GBy.h, baseUnitConversionFactor=3.6e12 By.s). If Google instead billed the nominal 30 'GB', RAM would be $79.62/mo instead of $85.49/mo (total $476.87/mo).

c4d-highcpu-32.note_c4d_ram: C4D RAM SKU is priced per decimal GB (GBy.h, baseUnitConversionFactor=3.6e12 By.s). If Google instead billed the nominal 60 'GB', RAM would be $159.23/mo instead of $170.97/mo (total $953.74/mo).

egress.note: Tiers are GiB/month, aggregated per billing ACCOUNT per SKU (aggregationInfo). Multiply MEASURED bytes/request x requests/month / 2^30 to get GiB. 1 RPS sustained = 2,628,000 req/month at 730 h (the doc used 30 d = 2,592,000).
egress.inter_zone_caveat: SKU DE9E-AFBC-A15A serviceRegions lists us-central1/us-east1/us-west1/asia-east1/europe-west1 only; the catalog has no asia-south1-specific VM inter-zone SKU.
